test_title: PYST 32: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

It had been _________ a pleasure to meet you!
solution:
The correct answer is "**such**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we will use **such **which is a **determiner**.
 
• We use "such" in a sentence to add **emphasis**.
 
• The meaning of such is "**very**" or "**to this degree**"
 
• The determiner "**such**" is used before a noun or an adjective.
 
 
• **Example**: *He is **such **__a boring host.*
 
 
 
• The use of **such** is usually followed by "**a**" or "**an**".
 
• In the given sentence, we can see the article "**a**" is present after the blank.
 
• When we use **such **directly with a **noun**, it is usually to offer an **opinion **on someone or something.
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is expressing that the meeting had been a pleasurable experience.

**The correct sentence is**:* It had been __**such**__ a pleasure to meet you!*

Hence, the correct sentence is** option 2.**
